name: Controlled Unclassified Information
notes: NASA procedural requirements for implementing the CUI program. Decomposed into 72 requirements in catalog/nasa/npr-2810-7/.

derives_from.note: Implements the CUI program established by executive order.
Implements the federal CUI regulation for NASA.
Procedural implementation of NASA's information security policy.
FISMA requires agency-level information security procedures.

references.note: References 800-53 controls for CUI security requirements.
References 800-171 for CUI protection in nonfederal systems.
References FIPS 199 for CUI security categorization.
References FIPS 140-2 for cryptographic protection of CUI.
References the NARA CUI Registry for category definitions.
References CUI Marking Handbook for marking procedures.
References FOIA for CUI dissemination and exemptions.
References Privacy Act for PII-related CUI categories.
References OMB policy for information management requirements.
